name: Nesvady (Slovakia)
description: A yellow field with narrow vertical stripes of black, yellow, dark red and black near the hoist, ending at the fly in a swallowtail whose notch reaches one third of the flag's length.
history: The flag's colours are taken from the municipal arms, as required for Slovak municipal symbols; arms and flag are registered in the Heraldic Register of the Slovak Republic under signature N-54/97..
